title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Billing Error Training Questions: Missing-Credit Accrual Days
content:
**What are the missing-credit accrual days?** For a notice that a Marlowe & Finch refund settled to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account has not been credited, the missing-credit accrual days follow the latest statement and the refund date. When the latest statement charged purchase interest and the refund was issued on or before the latest statement date, they are the calendar days from the latest statement date to the notice date. When the latest statement charged purchase interest and the refund was issued after the latest statement date, they are the calendar days from the refund date to the notice date. When the latest statement charged no purchase interest, they are zero.

**Which date is the refund date?** The date of the cardmember's most recent Marlowe & Finch refund record settled to the card tender, in the Merchandise Purchases records.

**Does a minimum interest charge count as purchase interest here?** No. Only purchase interest charged on the latest statement counts.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: latest statement dated 30 June, notice received 20 July)

| Latest statement charged | Refund dated | Accrual days |
|---|---|---|
| purchase interest | 10 June | from 30 June to 20 July: 20 |
| purchase interest | 14 July | from 14 July to 20 July: 6 |
| only a minimum interest charge | any | 0 |
| no interest | any | 0 |
